title: Breaking Bias, Building Bridges: Evaluation and Mitigation of Social Biases in LLMs via Contact Hypothesis

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the percentage of biased responses (e.g., refusal to engage) to prompts simulating intergroup contact across various societal scenarios using HOLISTICBIAS descriptors, supplemented by question-answering accuracy evaluation on the BBQ benchmark.
